title: Rational comparisons on the explicit tensor-Hom direct image
statement: For a prime $\ell$, an algebraic closure $\Omega/\mathbf Q_\ell$, and any scheme morphism $f:Z\to X$, integral comparison data satisfying HasIntegralLaws and HasIntegralCoherence admit Comparisons satisfying HasComparisonLaws [def-sf-strict-direct-image-scalar-data]. Construct the functor by tensor extension of the integral Hom map and combine its literal object/pure-tensor formulas with descended rational coherence. The rational functor at every field is required to equal rationalImage.

source.place: Agent-expanded strict scalar comparison argument, original DAG Steps 1--8; current blueprint retains only the underlying closed-immersion argument.

proof.text: Apply [lem-pur-semilinear-scalar-localization] to $I_E$ and the scalar functors. Its inversion hypothesis holds: $t_E$ is nonzero in $R_L$ and, by [lem-weil-l-adic-extension-integers-dvr] and the valuation inclusion in [def-weil-integral-scalar-extension], $t_E=u t_L^e$ for a unit $u$ and an integer $e\geq1$; it is invertible in $L=R_L[1/t_L]$. Step 2 supplies linearity of $I_E$, and [lem-weil-integral-scalar-extension-constructible] supplies semilinearity of the scalar functors. On raw rationalizations the functors act on $h/t_E^n$ by $I_E(h)/t_E^n$ and $S_{L/E}(h)/t_E^n$, respectively. Their objects are the same integral representatives by [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi]. Localize the components $d_{L/E,K}$ to obtain $\theta_{L/E,K}$; the same lemma extends naturality to all fractions and preserves inverses, compositions, whiskering, shift squares and the unit and associator equations. Thus Steps 5 and 7 give exactly the displayed rational cocycle and shift compatibility. The associators are the prescribed $a^W$ by Step 4. This construction adds no objects or idempotent splittings.
